prompts.dependency-tracking: Use case: infographic-diagram. One landscape Chinese technical blog interior infographic, aspect about 1.805:1. Reference images define the approved series style: deep royal navy blue, clean white Chinese typography, cyan-to-green borders, very subtle luminous bottom ribbon and small feather emblem lower left. Use generous spacing, clear readable short labels, restrained flat cards. Mark with article ID and “示意图”. No fake screenshot, no evidence of passed tests, no checkmarks, no invented brand logos. Only show the specified content. Preserve exact identifiers, correct Chinese. Title “两种状态传播模型”. Subtitle “M7-04 · 示意图”. Two horizontal lanes: “Vue” with three nodes “响应式读取收集依赖” → “写入通知订阅者” → “相关计算与视图更新”; “React” with three nodes “状态 setter” → “安排组件重新渲染” → “形成新的渲染快照”. Under Vue small caption “computed 追踪响应式依赖”; under React “Memo / Effect 使用显式依赖”. Bottom “业务结果相同，运行模型不同”. Do not imply every React state update always changes DOM or every ordinary Vue read tracks outside reactive effect.
